subject: *: support setting txn-entry-size-limit by sys var (#49237)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs parent in the requested scope. It introduces sysvar `tidb_txn_entry_size_limit` (global+session, unsigned, 0=use config, max=120MB) in `pkg/sessionctx/variable/sysvar.go`/`pkg/sessionctx/variable/tidb_vars.go`, stores session value in `SessionVars.TxnEntrySizeLimit` (`pkg/sessionctx/variable/session.go`), and applies the override at txn creation time in `LazyTxn.changePendingToValid` (`pkg/session/txn.go`) via a new txn option `kv.SizeLimits` (`pkg/kv/option.go`) handled by the TiKV txn driver (`pkg/store/driver/txn/txn_driver.go`) by updating `UnionStore().SetEntrySizeLimit`. Confirmed all `TxnEntrySizeLimit`/`SizeLimits` references are updated and no unexpected call sites remain. Checked later history up to `upstream/master` for follow-up changes involving `tidb_txn_entry_size_limit`; subsequent commits touching the string are outside the reviewed modules or large refactors, and do not indicate an unfixed Blocker/High issue within this commit’s scoped changes.
